newsitem.title: JAPAN: Some Japan banks, brokerages fall to new 1997 lows.
newsitem.headline: Some Japan banks, brokerages fall to new 1997 lows.

text.p: Some issues in the banking and securities sectors fell to new lows for the calendar year on Wednesday afternoon as dissolution of cross shareholdings continued, brokers said.

As of 0525 GMT, shares of Daiwa Securities Co Ltd was down 21 yen at 724, and Wako Securities Co Ltd had lost 35 yen to 430. Cosmo Securities Co Ltd shed 10 to 178. All three were at new lows for the year.
Daiwa Bank Ltd slipped six yen to 350 and Sumitomo Bank Ltd 50 yen to 1,270.

"Sell orders coming from elimination of cross shareholdings as well as porfolio reshuffling is sending some issues in the sector to new lows, day after day," a broker at a middle-sized brokerage said.
